linkedin.headline: Research & scientific software | AI-directed tools and demos | CSULB BUILD Scholar | Aspiring MD/PhD
linkedin.about:
I study computer science and physics at Cal State Long Beach, with a minor in biology. I'm a BUILD Scholar working toward MD/PhD training.

I direct AI agents across more than software: running a home estate of several machines, producing research reports, disk and ops cleanup, and building this site. I set the bar and decide what ships.

My research experience spans gait and rehabilitation, behavioral neurobiology, protein molecular dynamics, and collaborative surgical-ergonomics work. I'm interested in measurement, reproducible analysis and scientific software.

Checks come before claims. I keep runnable examples, source and explicit limits with the work. Research contributions are collaborative; synthetic demos are not evidence of clinical validity, learning gains or savings on someone else's data.

Public work you can explore:
• RecallWeave: Offline learning toolkit with visible Bayesian estimates, lesson authoring and interactive labs; no measured learning-gain claim. https://jacobmetoyer.com/RecallWeave/explore.html
• ReturnBy: Local-first return deadlines and calendar reminders; review extracted fields and merchant rules. https://jacobmetoyer.com/returnby/
• TowerOps: Synthetic airspace workbench with approval and readback gates; not operational ATC. https://jacobmetoyer.com/TowerOps/airspace/
• Aetherline: Relic Run: Hamon Engine browser prototype; WebGPU required, private engine source, no browser audio. https://jacobmetoyer.com/games/aetherline/
• Multi-agent Fan-out Engine: Sanitized reference core for dependency planning and dispatch reconciliation; not a production-capacity benchmark. https://github.com/Jacob-Met/multi-agent-fanout-engine
• ShadeWindow: Submitted historical heat-index replay demo; not a safety forecast. https://devpost.com/software/shadewindow

Portfolio: https://jacobmetoyer.com/
Source: https://github.com/Jacob-Met
